note: This file declares requested desktop choices; it does not itself start a compositor. The live userspace must parse the Multiboot command line, validate the installed session manifest, launch the selected session, and emit a real readiness marker. The host X11 launcher can store a user preference for aurora, marine, freexp or freewin11; the boot-time native session manager does not yet consume that preference, so the boot default remains aurora. Session launch remains prototype-only.

fallback.reason: desktop session missing, compositor startup failed, or readiness timeout
